user_input: Which mitigation options have direct, active mitigates relationships in Enterprise ATT&CK 17.1 to the technique mapped to Advanced Internet Protocol (IP) Scanner in AA23-165A? Start from LockBit affiliates and follow the three-hop actor-to-software-to-technique-to-mitigation path. Distinguish advisory observations from reference recommendations.
response:
LockBit affiliates' activity may be mitigated by disabling or removing unnecessary ports and services. [E6, E5]
LockBit affiliates' activity may be mitigated by using network intrusion prevention systems that use network signatures. [E8, E9, E1]
LockBit affiliates' activity may be mitigated by using network intrusion prevention systems that use network signatures to identify traffic for specific adversary command and control infrastructure and malware. [E8, E9, E1]
Network Intrusion Prevention (M1031) mitigates Network Service Discovery (T1046) by detecting and preventing remote service scans. [E2, E1]
Disable or Remove Feature or Program (M1042) mitigates Network Service Discovery (T1046) by disabling or removing unnecessary ports and services. [E6, E5]
